feeds.what: page 1 of 20 of the statewide results: the first 10 contests (Governor, Lieutenant Governor, United States Senator, US House districts 1–7) plus the statewide header (ballots cast, counties reported, last updated)
feeds.notes: Server-rendered ASP.NET WebForms page; 112,442 bytes decoded, 11,497 on the wire (gzip). Cache-Control: public, max-age=60. A GET only ever returns page 1: '&page=2' is ignored ('Page: 1 of 20' again). Pages 2–20 (where the state legislature and amendments must be) and the 'Export Data' link are javascript:__doPostBack(...) links, i.e. a form POST carrying __VIEWSTATE and __EVENTVALIDATION (targets cmdNext / cmdNext_top / hlnkExportData). The brief forbids submitting forms, so NEITHER was exercised: what 'Export Data' returns (format, size) is unknown. Each contest is a <table class="contestTable"> with the title in <td class="enrContestHeader"> and one row per candidate (name cell class enrCandNameCol, percent span, votes in div.numberValue).

election_id: 1001305, the ecode query parameter (2026 General Election).
discovery: No list endpoint found. https://www.sos.alabama.gov/alabama-votes carries a link 'View Unofficial Election Night Results for 2026 General Election' → …/statewideResultsByContest.aspx?ecode=1001305; scrape that link for the current ecode. https://www2.alabamavotes.gov/electionNight/ with no ecode is an empty page.
cors: none (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the HTML page when sent Origin: https://openslate.us)
bot_blocking: Plain relay User-Agent: 200 (Server: cloudflare, cf-cache-status MISS, no challenge). Headless Chrome also loads it. Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: In the HTML header block: 'Last Updated: 11/04/2026 11:16:06 AM' (no zone shown; Alabama is US Central). The HTTP Last-Modified header was the fetch time, so it is not useful.
reporting_field: Statewide only, in the header block: 'Counties Reported: 67 of 67', 'Total Ballots Cast: 1,693,621', 'Total Registered Voters: 3,852,947', 'Voter Turnout: 43.96%'. No per-contest precinct or county reporting figure on the statewide page.
choice_format: Name padded with spaces then the party in parentheses, in one table cell: 'Doug Jones                             (DEM)' → collapse whitespace to 'Doug Jones (DEM)'; 'Tommy Tuberville (REP)'; write-ins are a row 'Write-In ' with no party. Votes use thousands separators ('806,253'). Measure format not seen (measures are on later pages).
district_field: Only in the title, as an ordinal: 'UNITED STATES REPRESENTATIVE, 1ST CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT'. No separate field.
terms: On the page itself: 'The election results presented on these pages are unofficial and presented as a courtesy of the Alabama Secretary of State and Alabama's Probate Judges. The accuracy of the election results is the responsibility of the Probate Judge for each county reporting.' (https://www2.alabamavotes.gov/electionNight/statewideResultsByContest.aspx?ecode=1001305). Nothing about automated access found.
